thread:
alex: quick pulse check before I lock the release note and announce window. aiming for a narrow hotfix deploy tomorrow 08:00 PST. public RN should be minimal; internal gets the full rollback/runbook. thoughts?
priya: minimal public is good. suggest 2 bullets + optional link to internal doc. keeps support churn low.
liam: ops note 1: our maintenance window is 08:0008:20 PST. we can stretch to 08:30 but prefer <10m runway for the actual service replacement.
kate: technical detail 1: this is a config-only change + new kernel flag. plan to pin release tag `release-2026-04-configfix`. canary 1m -> if stable advance to 100% at 6m.
alex: rollback criteria? we should codify in RN.
priya: set rollback on either: (a) 5xx rate > 0.8% across 3 minutes OR (b) p99 spike > 400ms for more than 2 minutes. command: `deploybot rollback release-2026-03-stable`.
liam: ops wants deploybot to post explicit health snapshots in thread and a loud channel ping on failure. also request auto-route to warm spare pool on GPU oom.
opsbot: noted. will post summary cards and @channel on failure. spare-pool fallback enabled for this tag.
deploybot: queued by alex for tag release-2026-04-configfix -> canary start scheduled at 2026-04-03T15:00:00Z (simulated). status updates will follow.
kate: ops checklist for the slot:
```
- pause hourly batch jobs
- turn on debug logging for model-service
- lower read replicas traffic threshold
- set healthcheck to /_live?fast
```
liam: adding monitor alerts to the thread: request anomaly alerting on token memory and KV cache growth.
priya: public RN draft (2 bullets): "fixes batch timeout on short sequences" and "improves memory handling during long chats". internal RN will include rollout steps, pin snippet for SDKs, and rollback triggers.
alex: +1. reserve publish of public RN until we have a 10-minute post-deploy snapshot (target 08:20 PST). internal announcement goes out immediately when canary begins.
deploybot: canary started 1: 1/4 nodes, 15% traffic. initial health checks ok. posting metrics summary in 2m.
kate: SDK pin snippet I1m adding to RN:
```
client.setModel("inference-v2", { pin: "release-2026-04-configfix" })
```
liam: if we need to rollback, remember to unpin in downstream CI before rolling to avoid mixed clients.
priya: legal signoff? any privacy changes?
alex: checked with legal earlier; no customer-visible data changes. safe to proceed.
deploybot: canary 3m report: 0 errors, p95 stable. advancing to 60% at 2026-04-03T15:04:00Z.
liam: metrics green. holding till +10m then finalize public RN publish.
alex: thanks all. i'll post the internal announce now and queue the public blurb for 08:20 PST. will keep this thread as the single source for deploy logs.
